messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: connectBluetooth

message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
It lists the federal holidays that either fall on a Friday/Monday or are observed on the nearest weekday, together with the full weekend that the holiday extends into.  

| # | Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if weekend) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---|---------|-----------|-----------------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | **New Year’s Day** | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–2** | 2‑day weekend (no extra day). |
| 2 | **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, etc.) | Monday Feb 20 | — | **Feb 18–20** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 3 | **Good Friday** | Friday Apr 7 | — | **Apr 7–9** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 4 | **Victoria Day** | Monday May 22 | — | **May 20–22** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 5 | **Canada Day** | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 6 | **Labour Day** | Monday Sep 4 | — | **Sep 2–4** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 7 | **Thanksgiving** | Monday Oct 9 | — | **Oct 7–9** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 8 | **Remembrance Day** | Friday Nov 11 | — | **Nov 11–13** | 3‑day weekend. |
| 9 | **Christmas Day** | Monday Dec 25 | — | **Dec 23–25** | 3‑day weekend. |
|10 | **Boxing Day** | Tuesday Dec 26 | — | — | Not a long weekend. |

### Quick‑reference summary

| Long‑Weekend | Holiday | Dates |
|--------------|---------|-------|
| Jan 1–2 | New Year’s Day (observed Jan 2) | Jan 1–2 |
| Feb 18–20 | Family Day | Feb 18–20 |
| Apr 7–9 | Good Friday | Apr 7–9 |
| May 20–22 | Victoria Day | May 20–22 |
| Jul 1–3 | Canada Day (observed Jul 3) | Jul 1–3 |
| Sep 2–4 | Labour Day | Sep 2–4 |
| Oct 7–9 | Thanksgiving | Oct 7–9 |
| Nov 11–13 | Remembrance Day | Nov 11–13 |
| Dec 23–25 | Christmas Day | Dec 23–25 |

> **Pro‑Tip for App Integration**  
> Store each holiday as an object with fields: `name`, `date`, `observedDate` (if applicable), and `longWeekendStart/End`.  
> Then, when rendering a calendar view, you can highlight the entire span (`longWeekendStart` to `longWeekendEnd`) for a visual “long‑weekend” cue.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like province‑specific holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.) or a more detailed breakdown!
